# void_cart_for_pocket { #mofography.pocket_framework_env.void_cart_for_pocket }

```python
pocket_framework_env.void_cart_for_pocket(
    regions_pbc,
    regions,
    dgrid,
    rep,
    shape,
    atoms,
    *,
    prefer_fragment=True,
    max_samples=MAX_VOID_SAMPLES,
    shell_near_max_a=VOID_SHELL_MAXIMUM_A,
)
```

Cartesian void sample points for pocket ``rep``.

Uses ``regions == rep`` when that fragment exists and is not huge vs ``regions_pbc``;
otherwise falls back to ``regions_pbc == rep`` (subsampled).
